manifest.protocol: Common origins require 24h+one step of complete history and all next6h readings. No imputation. All five future targets stay within split. Train-only scaling and quantiles; validation-only early stopping, Ridge alpha and interval calibration. No Q4 tuning in this run.
manifest.confirmation_caveat: October–December was inspected in earlier experiments; reused confirmation is exploratory, not a fresh independent lockbox.
manifest.adaptive_calibration_note: Exploratory diagnostic added after static intervals undercovered confirmation. Both 7-day and 30-day windows are reported without selecting a winner on confirmation. Only resolved forecast errors with target time <= current forecast origin are used.
